name: ctxquilt
description: Pack compact, reproducible repository context bundles for coding agents.

scripts.smoke: npm run build && node dist/cli.js pack --include README.md --budget 2000 --output /tmp/ctxquilt-smoke.md && node dist/cli.js explain /tmp/ctxquilt-smoke.md
scripts.release:check: npm run check && npm test && npm run package:smoke

author: Roger Chappel
